Strategy: Combine Best Fit with a distribution-relative window: take the midpoint of the smallest and largest residuals, then penalize bins far from that midpoint on top of the tightness score. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest bin sits far below the midpoint while another bin sits near it, so a middle bin can win. This may preserve extreme bins, but the midpoint can be poor when residuals cluster at extremes.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    mid = (min(bins) + max(bins)) / 2
    return [-(r - item) - abs(r - mid) / 2 for r in bins]
```
